dense_layer_target.selection: Faster Gemmini policy for each measured FC layer and input

definitions.model_cycles: rdcycle around complete ordinary-firmware TFLM Invoke
definitions.layer_cycles: Per-node interval in separate trace firmware, including host operator work
definitions.model_average: Arithmetic mean of two inputs for each model
definitions.aggregate: Sum of the four model means, equivalent to one invocation of each model
definitions.relative_speedup: Gemmini cycles divided by NPU cycles; greater than one favors NPU
definitions.gemmini_selection: One faster complete-model policy per model, chosen by mean ordinary Invoke
definitions.initialization: Reported separately and excluded from Invoke
definitions.time_conversion: cycles / 100000 gives milliseconds at an assumed 100 MHz

current_source_validation.npu_validation: Measured source files match the current repository

target_1000.workload: One inference from each model, using the mean of its two inputs
